intended_message: Wearer wants to extend cash runway to 18 months by cutting paid marketing spend

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: Hey Alex, I think we can stretch our runway to like eighteen months if we kill paid spend.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Wait, runway? You mean cash runway or the runway for the pilot launch?

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: Oh cash, sorry. Like if we pause ads we're good till early twenty-seven.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Got it, okay yeah let's run the numbers tomorrow then.
